headline: Last session: Sensex jumped nearly 900 points as Nifty reclaimed 22,500 led by a rally in IT stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: Significant jump in IT stocks, with the sector gaining 3% in the last session
Broad-based recovery as all sectoral indices ended in the green on Friday
Positive sentiment following SEBI's plan to issue new CAS guidelines within a week
Strong buying in FMCG stocks which gained over 2% during Friday's trade
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 900 points to settle at higher levels after Thursday's sharp crash
TCS and Vedanta are among the key stocks in focus this week due to dividend record dates
Finance Minister Sitharaman is engaging with global investors to discuss Indian market opportunities
Geopolitical risks have escalated following a missile strike on a passenger terminal at Riyadh airport
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets staged a strong recovery with the Sensex jumping nearly 900 points to close above 22,500. The rally was driven by a 3% surge in IT stocks and gains in the FMCG sector. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday.
